title: Credo (Gaspar, Missa O venus bant)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Missa O venus bant, Credo. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0102c), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. I. Masses, Part 1, 2016); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
